facts.name: Catmint 'Walker's Low'
facts.notes: Billowing gray-green mounds with lavender-blue flowers for months; shear back after the first flush. Cats may roll in it.
facts.toxSrc: ASPCA lists catnip (catmint) as toxic to cats
